deviations.description: check-extension-docs.sh (gate 3) surfaced two real defects from Phase 5's own edit: EXTENSION.md grew to 70 lines (Rule U's 60-line limit) and per-repo-scoping.md's index-entries.json line_count entry went stale (declared 281, actual 300, Rule R)
deviations.reason: Trimmed EXTENSION.md's Postflight wrapup and What-this-extension-adds paragraphs (deferring full contract detail to per-repo-scoping.md, which already carries it) back to exactly 60 lines. Ran generate-context-line-counts.sh --write (deployed copy; source-store-only refused by deploy-root-guard.sh) to regenerate every stale line_count, which also corrected two PRE-EXISTING, task-caused (not drive-by) entries in core/index-entries.json for return-metadata-file.md and issue-log.md -- both edited in Phase 1, whose line_count entries were never regenerated at the time. file_scope was widened (state-write.sh, dry-run verified first) to include both index-entries.json files before committing, since these are genuinely this task's own files, not an accidental excursion. Re-ran verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 3,4 and check-extension-docs.sh directly afterward: the only remaining FAIL lines are the 8 expected pre-redeploy 'deployed script content drift' entries for this task's own edited files, resolved by Phase 6's redeploy -- zero other doc-lint violations remain.
Confirmed accurate as-is: the new postflight-sapience-notes.sh site does not add a write path, it mechanizes the existing sapience-remember.sh one, so the census count is unchanged. No edit made.

Left unedited: sapience-write-path.md is outside this task's declared file_scope and the plan's own instruction was check-and-report, not fix.
